mapper.select: SELECT p_productId, p_title, p_link, p_image, p_lprice, p_hprice, p_mallName, p_productType, p_brand, p_maker, p_category1, p_category2, p_category3, p_category4 FROM product WHERE p_productId = #{value} LIMIT 1

SELECT p_productId, p_title, p_link, p_image, p_lprice, p_hprice, p_mallName, p_productType, p_brand, p_maker, p_category1, p_category2, p_category3, p_category4 FROM product ORDER BY p_productId DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET p_title = #{p_title}, p_link = #{p_link}, p_image = #{p_image}, p_lprice = #{p_lprice}, p_hprice = #{p_hprice}, p_mallName = #{p_mallName}, p_productType = #{p_productType}, p_brand = #{p_brand}, p_maker = #{p_maker}, p_category1 = #{p_category1}, p_category2 = #{p_category2}, p_category3 = #{p_category3}, p_category4 = #{p_category4} WHERE p_productId = #{p_productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( p_productId, p_title, p_link, p_image, p_lprice, p_hprice, p_mallName, p_productType, p_brand, p_maker, p_category1, p_category2, p_category3, p_category4 ) VALUES ( #{p_productId}, #{p_title}, #{p_link}, #{p_image}, #{p_lprice}, #{p_hprice}, #{p_mallName}, #{p_productType}, #{p_brand}, #{p_maker}, #{p_category1}, #{p_category2}, #{p_category3}, #{p_category4} )
